From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>

Date: 2027-07-12T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Hiring slate: candidate casebook + bar-raiser alignment

Hi team,

We have Priya Sharma (applied for Sr. Inference Engineer) moving to on-site stage next week. Hiring committee: Marissa (HM), Grace (CS/owner), Markus (bar-raiser), Lauren (platform-leveling). I pulled together a short "casebook" (attached) with two 30-minute scenario prompts and a 20-minute architecture deep-dive. Please review the ask below before interviews: 

- Role scope we want to validate: multi-model serving tradeoffs, latency SLOs, KV cache correctness, and mitigations for degraded GPUs.
- Leveling expectations: Senior = designs for 1–2 team projects end-to-end; clear tradeoff articulation; owns rollout strategy.
- Bar-raiser ask (Markus): please focus on evidence of ownership breadth across runtime and orchestration.

Logistics: candidate availability below — Arielle from TalentLoop coordinated. I attached the candidate resume and the casebook. Please confirm if we should swap the 30-min scenario order (candidates tend to be fresher on architecture early).

Attachments: casebook_interview_prompt_v2.pdf, priya_sharma_resume.pdf, hiring_slate_checklist.xlsx

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Sr. TPM, Talent Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Arielle Johnson <arielle@talentloop.com>
Date: 2027-07-12T10:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hiring slate: candidate casebook + bar-raiser alignment

Thanks Neha — reviewed the casebook. A couple quick notes before we lock calendar: 

- I prefer architecture deep-dive first (20 min) so we can prime the candidate for the two scenario prompts; helps when we watch for design coherence across scenarios.
- Grace: can you own the TL;DR at the top of the casebook for interviewers (3 bullets per prompt: signal, red flags, desired follow-ups)?
- Markus: we'd like you to run the bar-raiser segment in the final 15 minutes; main ask is cross-cutting ownership question set (rollout + incident postmortem examples).

Arielle — candidate windows: Priya is available Tue/Wed 9–12 PT and Thu 1–4 PT. I've tentatively held Tue 9:30–11:30 for the loop (stacked 30/30/30 + 20 debrief). Please send updated invite when we confirm.

Subject: Re: Hiring slate: candidate casebook + bar-raiser alignment

Quick confirm — I reviewed the casebook and the leveling notes. Two specific asks for my bar-raiser slot: 

1) Start with "Tell me about a time you owned a rollout end-to-end" — probe for explicit escalation decisions and their reasoning.
2) Follow with an incident table (ask candidate to sketch a short timeline of a production incident and the key remediation decisions).

Also — given scope we described, if candidate struggles to place KV caching/latency tradeoffs into rollout decision-making, recommend we keep the loop as a no-hire conversation. I'll draft a 3-line rubric we can paste into the debrief doc.

-Markus
Principal Inference Engineer (bar-raiser)
Redwood Inference
